'''Sulamar''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This Moff led the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector's]] [[Nineteenth Army]] from its headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Javin]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sulamar was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', by [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> Before the publication of the [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Essential Guide]], [[Sulamar|another Imperial of the same name]] had been introduced in the novel [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]. It is interesting to note that that Sulamar, an Imperial technician, was in charge of the [[Darksaber (superweapon)|Darksaber]] Project,<ref name="DS">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> while Moff Sulamar was the head of the Nineteenth Army, also called "Dark Saber Command."<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
